prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Reordering onboarding steps (moving sign-in after adoption) was helpful and exceeded predictions (+16.8% measured vs +12.0% predicted).
Live progress visualizers on the waiting screen were helpful and far exceeded predictions (+9.3% measured vs +2.0% predicted), whereas static time estimates and error safeguards on the same screen showed no clear effect.
Finish screen additions (control guides and notification prompts) showed no clear effect, and predictions were set too high.
Adoption grid layout changes showed no clear effect, with predictions (+15.0%) being overly optimistic.
Copy adjustments for path selection showed no clear effect, over-predicting impact (+8.0%).
Account sync safeguard warnings showed no clear effect, with predictions (+3.0%) being too high.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, layout: +2.4% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, copy: +0.6% over 1 test(s)
- finish, new_flow: -6.6% over 1 test(s)
- finish, notification: -5.4% over 1 test(s)
- home, wait_info: +2.9% over 2 test(s)
- sign_in, hint: +4.2% over 1 test(s)
- sign_in, reorder: +16.8% over 1 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 83.1%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 84.2%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 21.1%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Photo Upload Step Card Layout Redesign: Redesign the photo upload screen into a structured card layout with custom photo picker controls to make pet photo submission smooth. (why: Adoption has the lowest conversion rate in the funnel at 60.9% and a high mean time of 1017s, plus support received 3 tickets about custom pet generation failures.)
1: [home, wait_info] Interactive Mascot Progress Updates: Add an animated mascot helper and step counter to the waiting screen while pet generation finishes. (why: Live progress visualizers on waiting screens previously boosted conversion by +9.3% and high waiting times (median 201s) need engagement.)
2: [sign_in, hint] Account Recovery & Sync Helper Hint: Add a clear explanatory hint on the sign-in screen informing users that signing in preserves their pet across re-installs. (why: 8 support tickets were submitted regarding pets missing or reset after signing in again.)
3: [adoption, copy] Adoption Certificate Confirmation Headline Redesign: Update adoption certificate copy with celebratory text and a prominent button to complete adoption. (why: Adoption drops off significantly with only 60.9% conversion and long completion times.)
4: [finish, incentive] First-Day Desktop Owner Badge Prompt: Display a celebratory owner badge component on the home intro screen upon completing setup. (why: Finish step dropoff is high at 64.8% conversion and median completion takes 395s.)
5: [choose_path, layout] Story Scroll Layout for Welcome Story: Change story screen layout to story_scroll with a calm descriptive text component. (why: Choose path mean duration is 514s, showing users take a long time to navigate initial app context.)

scores.note: Target step has highest dropoff and support tickets, but layout redesigns historically showed low impact.
Live progress visualizers on waiting screens consistently outperform predictions.
Strong support email signal; explanatory hints historically produce moderate positive lift.
High dropoff step, but simple copy adjustments have shown almost no effect in past tests.
Finish screen additions and prompts have historically shown negative or flat results.
